verdict.rationale: Preventing customer data from being used for AI training is a fair privacy question for a cloud document platform like SharePoint, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions training opt-outs, data-use commitments, or AI-training controls. The docs cover REST, Graph, SPFx and webhooks, and the community items concern usability and OAuth scoping, so none of them address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
